name: atr-operator
description: Operate atr (agent task runner) from Cursor: local stdio MCP or remote HTTP MCP, plus the atr skill.

ATR_MCP_HOST.title: atr host
ATR_MCP_HOST.description: Hostname that serves atr's /mcp over HTTPS, for example ai-stack.tailxxxx.ts.net from Tailscale Serve. No https:// and no /mcp; add :port only if HTTPS is not on 443.

ATR_MCP_TOKEN.title: atr MCP token (secret)
ATR_MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token from ~/.config/atr/mcp.token (or ATR_MCP_TOKEN) on the atr host. Secret: Cursor stores it and never shows it back.
